rule_or_requirement: Reduce costly pixel-road visibility excursions while preserving valid completion.
observable_information: Current and last visible pixel-road centers, private count of consecutive low-visibility decisions, inherited pixel actions.
allowed_action_or_state_change: For at most 20 low-visibility decisions, steer ±0.25 toward the last farthest visible road offset; inherit gas and brake.
expected_success_endpoint: All six consumed reference finishes retained, >=20 changed actions, and longest low-visibility streak shortened by >=10 decisions on at least two of three slow-loss cells.
control: Frozen exact visual mode-switch ZIP SHA b0dc7a24e6ef994cee6e663ec6605f5aa088dbb9b3ce4510f90ccd16dc9d7fc4 on six matched consumed TRAIN cells.
falsifier: Lost finish, invalid action, insufficient changed actions, or fewer than two target streaks shortened by ten decisions.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Two arms on six consumed TRAIN cells, 12 episodes.
resource_and_risk_gate: One registered local Linux CPU diagnostic capped at 1,200 seconds and 2,000 decisions/episode; no reserved split or external action.
